extracted.intended_audience: pr professionals, agency and in-house communicators, PRWeek readers (US market)
extracted.subtask_description: List of award categories used by PRWeek for its US Awards (winners announced) covering campaign types, people, education, and agency/talent recognitions; these categories implicitly define the dimensions on which PR work is judged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Campaign of the Year
rubrics_metrics.description: Award category: Campaign of the Year (top overall campaign award).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General guidance from page: the PRWeek Awards celebrate creative and effective earned-media PR across sectors; winners are chosen by a jury chaired for 2026 by Kelly McGinnis and are intended as exemplars for smart communicators.
